audit_scope: 15 diverse indexed resources covering primary laboratory datasets, field data, safety-style archive sources, reused EV/second-life cohorts, synthetic data and derived benchmarks.
methodology: Each record has at least one direct publisher/official repository/author publication or code-repository reference assessed. Findings reflect source claims, not independent file verification. Source URL and publisher publication are different forms of evidence.
limitations: Network restrictions and large archives prevented raw file acquisition. The 15-resource pilot is NOT 15 file-audited or fully validated datasets. No existing access_status, raw-file verification, labels, licence clearance or suitability grade should be upgraded based on this source check.
